title: Constrained Triple-Head Price Optimization (C3PO) Network for Discrete-Choice Models
summary: We propose a Constrained Triple-Head Price Optimization (C3PO) network for real-time bi-level decision making in discrete-choice environments. In these settings, a seller selects product or service offerings to achieve business objectives, while heterogeneous users make personalized acceptance or rejection decisions based on their preferences, ultimately determining seller outcomes.
